_doc: KJVA-1 / XMIND-1 locked baseline v1.1. DO NOT EDIT. Supersedes 2026-06-08 (adds grounded-refusal counter-witness thresholds + updated test count post runtime-retrieval-wiring merge 497ea3a).

governance.note: Hard floor. Any regression below 25/25 blocks promotion and flags a regression.

test_suite.note: Skipped count is stable; new tests must not increase failures.

grounding.note: Scripture retrieval must be live. generation_invoked must be False on all reference queries.

bpb_in_domain.note: BPB may not regress beyond +0.20 from canonical baseline.

determinism.note: 100% byte-identical at T=0. Any non-determinism at T=0 is a regression.

single_runtime_authority.note: Only one GGUF may be at training/gguf/ root. All others must be in archive/.

throughput_warm.note: Soft floor. Alert if warm throughput drops below 100 tok/s at 128 tokens.

cold_start_ms.note: Soft ceiling. Alert if cold start exceeds 800ms.

footprint_mb.note: Model footprint must not grow (quantization or architecture change would break this).

grounded_refusal.note: Constitutional denials must cite counter-witness scripture RETRIEVED from the corpus (never generated). Any fabricated verse in a denial, or loss of counter-witness retrieval, is a regression.
